Meta and WRI canopy height map

Tree canopy height worldwide on a grid of about 1 m, estimated by a machine-learning model from aerial imagery and trained on airborne lidar. The New York tile's imagery is from 2019 and 2020.

Publisher
Meta and the World Resources Institute (High Resolution Canopy Height Maps v2), published on Source Cooperative by Taylor Geospatial Engine Labs
Link
source.coop/tge-labs/meta-chm-v2 · papers: Tolan et al. 2024, Brandt et al. 2026
Licence
CC BY 4.0, © Meta / Data for Good
Used for
The trees in the side view: where each stands, how tall and how wide (trees.js)

A database of tall buildings with roof heights and drawings. The tower sprites are original, simplified drawings, made to these heights after looking at each tower's silhouette; nothing was traced or copied.

Publisher

Link

Licence

Used for

News and press releases

Used for facts about the machines and the schedule: tbm.js and status.js.

19 Nov 2026
$16B Hudson Tunnel project launches second tunnel boring machine · Construction Dive, quoting a GDC release of 18 Nov. Machine positions (TBM 1 about 400 ft into the north tube, TBM 2 just launched in the south tube), rock reached 50–60 ft down at the Hudson County Shaft, river boring in 2028. Used by status.js, tbm.js, geology.js.
28 Sep 2026
Governor Hochul celebrates start of tunnel boring · NY Governor's office. Ceremonial start, about 30 ft a day, Palisades contractor.
28 Sep 2026
Tunnel boring for $16B Hudson River tunnel project begins · 6sqft. Start date, first and second machine.
29 Sep 2026
$16B Hudson Tunnel Project begins boring · Construction Dive.
20 Aug 2025
Hudson tunnel TBMs nearly assembled · Construction Briefing. Machine size, advance rate, launch shaft.
13 Oct 2026
Tunnel boring begins on Gateway Hudson Tunnel rail project · Equipment World. River contract award, April 2026.
9 Oct 2026
Hudson Tunnel Project begins drilling into Palisades Cliffs · NJBIZ. Boring under way about 8 October.
30 Sep 2026
Tunnel boring begins on Hudson Tunnel Project (and, 18 Feb 2025, on track to be completed by 2035) · Mass Transit. Service date.
 
gatewayprogram.org · Gateway Development Commission. Project pages and updates.

News articles are the publishers' copyright; the tracker takes facts from them, not text or pictures. The 2035 and 2038 dates come from news coverage.

Page pictures are small renders of the listed pages, for reference. The full detail of what each page shows is in SOURCES.md. Back to the tracker.
